item.title: By: Cubic zirconia
item.dc:creator: Cubic zirconia
item.description: Most of the time the meaning of innovation remain unclear and it is not specific. Chances are it was abused in some occasions. Especially the time when my superior want to show off his authority, he always keep repeating I-word. Actually it seems so blank and weak with no solid content as backbone. But you have to accept it because he is the boss and you are the one bossed around.
